name: Hodge 2 (Hubble)
blurb: Hodge 2, an intermediate-age star cluster in the Large Magellanic Cloud, seen by Hubble.
label: h2-hubble
story: Hodge 2 is an intermediate-age star cluster in the Large Magellanic Cloud, a satellite galaxy of the Milky Way. Its red clump is extended rather than tight, one of the clues that such clusters are not the simple single-age crowds once assumed.

claims.text: Hodge 2 is a Large Magellanic Cloud cluster
Hodge 2 was a target of program 12257 on Magellanic Cloud star clusters
The Large Magellanic Cloud is a satellite galaxy of the Milky Way
Such clusters challenge the idea of simple stellar populations
Hodge 2 has an extended red clump
